summary: Euroholdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 1, 2026 press release announcing time charter contract extensions for two feeder containerships, M/V Joanna and M/V Aegean Express. The Joanna charter extends 30 months plus up to 20 days at $24,000/day from December 2026; the Aegean Express extends 24-26 months at $20,500/day from January 2027. Combined EBITDA is estimated at ~$24 million over the minimum period. This is routine commercial contract news, not a special situation.
